title: Agentic AI Testing Platform — platform.config.json
description: Repository-root configuration. The only required input for platform independence is the project root; every other path is derived from it by platform_core/tools/project_paths/.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file.

projectRoot.description: The project root — the single required input. Relative values resolve against the repository root; absolute values may point outside this repository entirely. Defaults to 'platform_core_data'.

generatedOutputDir.description: Where generated (non-maintained) artifacts are written — Playwright reports, traces, codegen output. Resolved relative to the PROJECT ROOT unless absolute. Must be isolated and gitignored; never mixed with maintained source code.

browserProvider.description: The active Browser Provider id. Skills invoke the Browser Provider interface, never a concrete browser tool. See platform_core/tools/browser_provider/README.md.

browserProviders.description: Registry of available Browser Provider implementations, keyed by provider id.

module.description: Repository-relative path to the provider implementation module.

command.description: For CLI-backed providers: the base command invoked (e.g. 'npx playwright').

debugMode.description: Debug Mode flag (pipeline.md §11). Default false: throwaway scripts and raw dumps are written outside the project tree and deleted after use.
